订阅链接必须是 http:// 或 https:// 开头: The subscription link must start with http:// or https://
设备码授权时，请按网关给出的指引在官方页面确认设备授权码。没有授权地址不等于失败: For device-code authorization, follow the gateway's instructions to confirm the device authorization code on the official page. A missing authorization URL does not mean failure; you may need to complete the operation in a client on the gateway machine. Rely on the status returned by the shared sign-in bridge.
设置不可隐藏（隐藏了只能清缓存找回来）: "Settings" cannot be hidden (you would have to clear storage to get it back)
设置已生效，但写入磁盘失败（重启后会恢复原设置）: Settings applied, but could not be saved to disk (will revert after restart)
该提供商已不在运行时目录中，请返回列表重新选择: This provider is no longer in the runtime catalog. Return to the list and select again.
该登录方式没有可选项，无法提交；请更新插件或联系作者: This sign-in method has no selectable options and cannot be submitted. Update the plugin or contact its author.
请允许安装未知来源应用后重试: Allow installing apps from unknown sources, then try again
请先在插件页授权签到及附带任务: Authorize check-in and bundled tasks on the Plugins page first
请先选择有效的 OAuth 登录方式: Select a valid OAuth sign-in method first.
请前往官网查看适用于本机的安装方式: Visit the official website for installation options for this device.
请填写非空的凭证 JSON 对象，且不超过 256 KiB: Enter a non-empty credentials JSON object no larger than 256 KiB.
请查看上方原因，稍后刷新重试。: See the reason above and refresh again later.
请根据不兼容原因更新插件或网关；不会要求两者版本号一致。: Update the plugin or gateway as indicated by the compatibility error. Their version numbers do not need to match.
请输入 {min}–{max} 之间的整数秒数: Enter a whole number of seconds between {min} and {max}
请选择非空且不超过 {n} MiB 的 zip 插件包: Select a nonempty zip plugin pack up to {n} MiB
读取受控任务权限失败，请手动刷新: Failed to load controlled task permission; please refresh manually
读取完成的插件会陆续显示，无需停留在此页面等待。: Plugins appear as their information loads. You can leave this page while loading continues.
读取服务器访问权限失败，请重试: Failed to load server access permissions. Retry.
账号不在当前队列里: The account is not in the current queue
账号已在全局队列第一位: Account is already first in the global queue
账号排序接口不可用，请确认网关与界面已更新: Account sorting API unavailable. Ensure both the gateway and interface are updated.
软件版本检查设置不可用: Software update check settings are unavailable.
输入这台网关的管理员账号与密码。: Enter this gateway's administrator account and password.
运行内存填 0 表示自动；降低并发上限不会主动中断请求，降低内存预算可能影响后续: Enter 0 for auto; lowering concurrency does not interrupt active requests, while lowering memory budget may affect subsequent allocations.
运行时不内置于安装包，首次安装脚本插件时自动下载并校验。: The runtime is not bundled with the installer. It is downloaded and verified when you first install a script plugin.
还没有安装任何提供商插件包: No provider plugin pack is installed yet
还没有订阅：粘贴订阅链接，或从图片识别二维码导入。: No subscriptions yet: paste a subscription URL, or scan a QR code from an image.
还没有选择对话模型：先在下方选一个（或去「设置 → AI 助手」里选）。: No chat model selected yet: pick one below (or under Settings → AI Assistant).
这一版没有提供 Android 安装包：{reason}: This release does not include an Android package: {reason}
这个包提供的提供商（可单独停用某一家）: Providers in this pack (each can be disabled separately)
这个面板没有管理员，用一把已启用的 API Key 访问（在桌面端「网关 Key: This panel has no admin account. Access it with an enabled API key (create one under Gateway keys on desktop).
这会真实发起上游请求并消耗额度: This sends a real upstream request and spends quota
这台网关没有管理员，用一把已启用的 API Key 访问（在桌面端「网关 Key: This gateway has no administrator. Use an enabled API key instead (create one on the desktop app's "Gateway Key" page).
这台网关还没有管理员。设置一个账号密码，之后用它登录。: This gateway has no administrator yet. Set an account and password, then use them to sign in.
这是旧插件的手动兼容入口，不代表支持任意凭证或登录方式。请仅粘贴该插件明确接受的: This is a manual compatibility entry for legacy plugins, not support for arbitrary credentials or sign-in methods. Paste only credentials JSON explicitly accepted by the plugin. The gateway passes it to account.normalize for validation and does not infer Token, Cookie or OAuth credentials.
这是真实的上游请求，与生产走同一条链路（会记账，报表排除）。: This is a real upstream request over the same path as production (it is billed but excluded from reports).
这段文本作为 system 消息排在对话最前面。工具的定义与当前配置概览由网关自: This text goes at the very front of the conversation as a system message. Tool definitions and the current config overview are appended automatically by the gateway, so don't write them here.
这里只管理模型探测等维护任务；签到、成长和领奖请到签到中心。: Only maintenance tasks such as model probes are managed here; visit Check-in Center for check-ins, growth, and rewards.
远端 Agent 的工具请求将自动批准；需要提问时返回空答案，由 Agent 继: Remote Agent tool requests will be auto-approved, returning empty answers to prompts so the Agent can proceed; this does not mean client tools actually ran.
连不上插件仓库，请检查网络或代理后重试: Cannot reach the plugin repository. Check your network or proxy and try again.
连接已有 SAP AI Core 部署：从网关本机导入凭据文件，按资源组获取模型: Connect existing SAP AI Core deployments by importing a credential file from the gateway machine and listing models per resource group. Does not create deployments or report quotas.
选择插件包后，文件清单会显示在这里: Selected plugin packs will appear here
通过 API Key 接入 River 对话与在线模型目录；插件不提供余额数值。: Connect River chat and its online model catalog via an API Key. The plugin does not report a balance amount.
通过 Magpie 原插件接入设备码登录、对话、模型目录、余额和每日签到。: Uses the original Magpie plugin for device-code sign-in, chat, model catalogs, balance and daily check-in.
通过社区插件接入 {providers}，可在设置中管理提供商，签到计划在签到中: Connects {providers} through a community plugin. Manage providers in settings and check-in schedules in Check-in Center.
部分信息未能更新，已读取的插件仍可查看。: Some information could not be updated. Previously loaded plugins remain available to browse.
部分插件的附带任务可能消耗额度、发送对话或创建及解散群聊。: Side tasks of some plugins may consume quota, send messages, or create and dismiss group chats.
都不注入（助手退化为纯聊天）: Nothing is injected (the assistant falls back to plain chat)
队列是一次性整表提交（后端按新顺序重编优先级），移动会连带调整其它组的相对次序。: The queue is submitted as a whole table at once (the backend renumbers priorities in the new order), so a move also shifts the relative order of other groups.
队列是一次性整表提交；位置越靠前，路由时越先被选中。: The queue is submitted as a whole table at once; the earlier the position, the sooner it is picked when routing.
需要网关本机环境: Requires the gateway machine's local environment
默认跟随软件的正式版和 beta 关注选择；单独设置只影响日常更新，最低版本补齐: Release channels follow the app by default. Custom channels affect only routine updates; required plugin updates select a package for the current app version.
默认跟随软件的自动检查和间隔。关闭自动检查后暂停插件自动更新；手动检查、安装和更: Automatic checks and intervals follow the app by default. Turning off automatic checks pauses automatic plugin updates; manual checks, installation and updates remain available.
（不会影响客户端登录态）: (does not affect the client's sign-in state)
（请下载与该平台对应的插件包）: (download the pack built for this platform)
